jobs.title: Head of Sales
jobs.description:
ABOUT KASTLE

Kastle is building the AI employee for consumer lending. We work with some of America's largest banks and mortgage lenders, helping them scale their contact center and compliance operations using autonomous AI Agents that process payments, originate loans, and help customers get a world class experience during the biggest financial decisions of their lives. We've processed over $2 billion in transactions and are backed by Insight Partners and Y Combinator. If you are interested in selling the best product in the market and help large enterprise lenders and banks transform their operations, apply below.


We just raised a $24M Series A and are growing fast! 




ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for our founding Head of Sales hire who can take a product with large ACVs, fast sales cycles and early PMF, and build out the team and systems to hyperscale as we move past founder-led sales.

This role requires an ability to: work directly with founders selling large deals, recruit, hire, evaluate and coach EAE and SAE talent, and act as a player coach when needed alongside reps as the business scales.

As you succeed in the role, you'll be responsible for building out a world-class GTM team to help Kastle dominate consumer lending across North America.

Location preference: San Francisco, CA.



WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own Kastle’s revenue number and the key sales components of reaching it, including hands-on deal management and coaching, buildout of the sales and sales management team, and revenue forecasting.

 - Work with the CEO and AEs to develop and execute strategic sales plans to penetrate key accounts in mortgage lending, servicing, and consumer banking.

 - Act as a recruiter, quality bar and coach across AEs, with a focus on building an enterprise SWAT team of EAEs and SAEs closing $1m+ ACV deals with banks and enterprise lenders.

 - Hire and coach reps that can navigate challenging, multi-stakeholder sales processes (C-suite, InfoSec, legal, and procurement) within large enterprise organizations

 - Build and maintain a strategic, hunter-first culture where reps are aggressive outbound, creative in storytelling, and strategic in how they use their champions to close 7 and 8 figure deals.


WHY JOIN KASTLE

 - Career-defining opportunity to build a GTM org and shape the future of consumer lending in one of the fastest-growing AI companies in financial services, backed by YC, Insight Partners, Emergence Capital, and Commerce Ventures

 - Sell a market leading AI platform that’s already live in production with 8 of the top 25 servicers in the country

 - Competitive base salary with uncapped commission potential

 - Executive equity options to share in the company's success

 - Influence not just revenue, but product direction, partnerships, and brand positioning

 - Ability to work side-by-side with a world-class founding team from Verkada, NVIDIA, Apple, Redfin, and Intuit.

 - Chance to work with cutting-edge AI technologies

 - Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance

 - 401(k) with company match
   


WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

 - 15+ years of formal sales experience, with a minimum of 7 years building or scaling teams focused on selling to large mid-market or enterprise organizations

 - Proven track record of consistently meeting or exceeding quota in a B2B SaaS environment as an individual contributor

 - Minimum 5 years of experience selling in a startup or high-growth technology company

 - Demonstrated success building teams in selling "net new" products or services that require market education

 - Willingness and ability to build an independent pipeline

 - Experience with modern sales tools and methodologies (e.g. Outreach, MEDDIC)

 - History of building strong relationships and referenceable network with C-level executives

 - Strong consultative selling skills with the ability to communicate challenging technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences

 - Proficiency in navigating complex, multi-stakeholder sales processes
   


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Experience as an early executive or sales hire or first non-founder executive hire at a startup

 - Experience selling to large banks and lenders

 - Extensive professional network within large banks and lenders
   

Application: Email rishi@kastle.ai with: (2 sentences max for each please!)

 - How long does it take for you to know if a rep will be successful, and how do you know

 - The most counter-intuitive thing you’ve learned about building an enterprise-focused sales team

 - Quota + attainment for your teams for your 2 most recent roles

 - An explanation of any short stints (less than 3 years)

jobs.title: Founding Growth Lead
jobs.description:
ABOUT KASTLE

Kastle is building the AI employee for banks. We work with some of America's largest financial institutions, helping them scale their contact center and compliance operations using autonomous AI Agents that process payments, originate loans, and help customers get a world class experience during the biggest financial decisions of their lives. We've processed over $2 billion in transactions and have raised a $24M Series A led by Insight Partners and Y Combinator. If you are interested in building AI that is applied in the real world where precision, reliability, and performance matter and redefine access to credit across the world, apply below.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Founding Growth Lead to build the systems and campaigns that bring Kastle into new accounts and markets.

You’ll figure out who we should reach, what matters to them, and how to get in front of them. You’ll write the message, launch the campaign, build the tools behind it, measure the response, and use what you learn to improve the next one. You’ll also own the product story across our website, sales materials, newsletter, and events.

This is a hands-on role with wide ownership. The right person is an excellent writer and a fast operator who can build with data, automation, and AI tools. They have the taste to make Kastle memorable and the discipline to see whether their work creates real sales opportunities.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Build a live map of our market. Identify target accounts, buyers, relationships, and opportunities across our current segments and new verticals. Keep account maps current as we meet prospects, win customers, and learn where Kastle can expand.
   

 - Create paths into important accounts. Work with our investors and broader VC network to identify relevant connections, prepare thoughtful outreach, and turn warm introductions into conversations.
   

 - Own outbound and marketing experiments. Build lists, develop a hypothesis for each audience, write the copy, and launch campaigns. Test different messages and channels by segment; track replies, meetings, and pipeline; and keep improving the targeting and positioning.
   

 - Build the growth tooling. Create agents, automations, dashboards, and workflows that help us maintain the market map, run campaigns, track leads and ads, and give sales a reliable view of what is working.
   

 - Own Kastle’s product messaging. Turn customer conversations and product capabilities into clear positioning, website copy, slides, sales materials, and a product newsletter built from scratch.
   

 - Own Kastle presence at Events. Plan and execute conferences, smaller events, and campaigns across the industries we serve. Own the audience, invitations, experience, sales preparation, and follow-up.
   

 - Find creative ways to reach buyers. Test ideas such as thoughtful gifting, podcasts, customer programs, and Kastle-hosted events. Choose ideas for the audience they reach and the conversations they can create, then execute them with care.
   


A PROJECT YOU MIGHT OWN

Build a market map that is living and auto-updates daily. Start with the accounts and buyers we want to reach. Connect them to our existing relationships, outreach, meetings, customers, and events. Create a way for the map to stay current as the team books new calls and launches new products then use it to decide which accounts to pursue and what to say to them.




WHO YOU ARE

 - Creative with good taste: You can develop a sharp message or an unusual campaign that feels right for a senior buyer.

 - Resourceful: You find a way forward one way or another. You never stop at a no. 

 - Fast and thorough: You move quickly without losing details, deadlines, or follow-up.

 - Technical and curious: You’re comfortable building with data, AI tools, automations, and integrations. You can learn a new tool quickly and know when a simple system beats a complicated one.

 - Analytical: You care whether a campaign produces the right conversations, and you change your approach when it doesn’t.

 - Highly independent: You can take an ambitious goal, decide what to do first, and own the work through execution.

 - High energy: You enjoy talking to people, testing ideas, and making things happen in the real world.

You may have worked in growth, product marketing, GTM engineering, founder’s office, or built something yourself. We care most about what you’ve personally created and the results it produced.



HOW TO APPLY

Send your resume or LinkedIn profile and one example of a campaign, event, or internal tool you built that you are proud of. Tell us what you owned, how you made decisions, and what happened as a result.
